name: Clepsydra ~Hikari to Kage no Juujika~
original_name: クレプシドラ～光と影の十字架～
source:
There is a world called Sheol between this world and the other world. There stands a church of light with a church of darkness underground, Clepsydra. One day, a girl, Eve, strays into the church. She doesn't know who she is and why she is there, but she gradually becomes friends with other residents. A while later, a deader appears in the church and the last judgement is about to take place. Using her ability, she reads the deader's mind and reveals his secret. Will Eve be able to lead the deader's soul to heaven...?

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
在现世与彼世之间，存在着一个名为希奥尔的世界。那里矗立着一座光之教会，地下则是名为克莱普西德拉的暗之教会。某天，少女夏娃误入教会。她不知道自己是谁，也不知道为何会来到这里，却逐渐与其他居民成为朋友。不久，一名死者出现在教会，最后的审判即将开始。她运用自己的能力读取死者的内心，揭开他的秘密。夏娃能否将死者的灵魂引向天国……？

[摘自Himeya Shop]
